| T-00-01 | N/A | accept | CLOSED | Wave 0 creates only test stubs — no production code, no attack surface. Rationale sound. |
| T-01-01 | Denial of Service | accept | CLOSED | Turborepo cache is local-only with no production impact. Rationale sound. |
| T-01-02 | Tampering | mitigate | CLOSED | `package.json:4` — `"packageManager": "pnpm@11.5.3"` pin confirmed. `pnpm-lock.yaml` file exists and is committed. |
| T-01-03 | Information Disclosure | accept | CLOSED | Local development only; no secrets in source files. Rationale sound. |
| T-01-04 | Elevation of Privilege | mitigate | CLOSED | `package.json:9-15` — all scripts invoke `turbo run <task>`; no sudo, no setuid, no privileged operations present. |
| T-02-01 | Information Disclosure | mitigate | CLOSED | `pool-manager.ts:41` — `onnotice: () => {}` suppresses postgres.js NOTICE logs. DATABASE_URL is not passed to any logger call. `migrate.ts` logs only error/success messages, not the connection string. |
| T-02-02 | Information Disclosure | mitigate | CLOSED | `tables.ts:5` — `parseInt(process.env.EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS \|\| '1536', 10)`. Range validation at `tables.ts:8-11` throws on values outside 128–4096. `.env.example:12` documents `EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS=1536` with Phase 2 label. |
| T-02-03 | Tampering | accept | CLOSED | All table definitions use Drizzle ORM type-safe builders (`pgTable`, `text`, `uuid`, etc.) — no raw SQL string interpolation. Rationale sound. |
| T-02b-01 | Denial of Service | mitigate | CLOSED | `pool-manager.ts:22` — `new LRUCache<string, Sql>({ max: maxTenants, ... })` with `maxTenants = 20` default. `idle_timeout` accepted from config (300s documented in `.env.example`). |
| T-02b-02 | Tampering | accept | CLOSED | `pool-manager.ts:36-44` — `databaseName` is passed as `database:` config option to `postgres()`, not interpolated into any SQL string. Rationale sound. |
| T-02b-03 | Elevation of Privilege | mitigate | CLOSED | `pool-manager.ts:36-44` — each call to `getPool(databaseName)` creates a distinct `postgres()` connection object targeting only the named database. No shared connection across tenants. |
| T-02b-04 | Denial of Service | mitigate | CLOSED | `migrate.ts:9` — `process.exit(1)` on missing DATABASE_URL. `migrate.ts:29` — `process.exit(1)` in catch block on migration failure. |
| T-03-01 | Information Disclosure | mitigate | CLOSED | `logger.ts:8-13` — `LogContext` interface contains only `tenantId?`, `brainId?`, `sessionId?`, `userId?`. No credential fields. JSDoc at `logger.ts:27` explicitly notes: "Never pass DATABASE_URL or secrets in LogContext." |
| T-03-02 | Information Disclosure | mitigate | CLOSED | `health.ts:17-26` — `HealthCheckResult` exposes only `status`, `checks.db`, `version?`, `timestamp`. No connection strings, usernames, or passwords. JSDoc at `health.ts:14` notes the restriction. |
| T-03-03 | Denial of Service | accept | CLOSED | SELECT 1 fast path; postgres.js built-in query timeouts. Rationale sound. |
| T-03-04 | Information Disclosure | accept | CLOSED | Intentional for debugging; logs are internal-only. Rationale sound. |
| T-04-01 | Tampering | accept | CLOSED | drizzle-kit generate reads only local TypeScript files. No external input surface. Rationale sound. |
| T-04-02 | Information Disclosure | mitigate | CLOSED | `0000_lyrical_scrambler.sql` — contains only DDL (`CREATE TABLE`, `CREATE INDEX`). No DATABASE_URL, credentials, or sensitive data present. |
| T-04-03 | Denial of Service | accept | CLOSED | Already fixed in implementation (tsconfig exclude pattern applied). No external attack surface. Rationale sound. |
| T-05-01 | Information Disclosure | mitigate | CLOSED | `server.ts:21` — `c.json(result, httpStatus)` where `result` is the output of `performHealthCheck`. The `HealthCheckResult` type (verified in T-03-02) contains only `status`, `checks.db`, `version`, `timestamp`. `server.ts` JSDoc at line 13 explicitly states: "Never includes DATABASE_URL, credentials, stack traces, or table names." |
| T-05-02 | Denial of Service | accept | CLOSED | Low value target; SELECT 1 fast path; no auth acceptable in Phase 1. Rationale sound. |
| T-05-03 | Spoofing | accept | CLOSED | Sql constructed by TenantPoolManager with env credentials; no external path to inject a forged Sql. Rationale sound. |
| T-05-04 | Tampering | accept | CLOSED | Only GET /health exposed; Hono does not permit path traversal on static routes. Rationale sound. |

## Accepted Risks Log

| Threat ID | Rationale |
|-----------|-----------|
| T-00-01 | Test-only scaffolds; zero production impact |
| T-01-01 | Local Turborepo cache; no production path |
| T-01-03 | Build artifacts in local dev only; CI is isolated |
| T-02-03 | Drizzle ORM type-safe builders eliminate SQL injection by construction |
| T-02b-02 | databaseName used as config identifier, not SQL string |
| T-03-03 | SELECT 1 < 1ms; postgres.js timeouts in place |
| T-03-04 | Tenant context logging is intentional and internal-only |
| T-04-01 | drizzle-kit reads local TS files only; no external input |
| T-04-03 | Already fixed; no external attack surface |
| T-05-02 | Low DoS value; auth not required in Phase 1 |
| T-05-03 | Sql constructed from env-controlled credentials; no external injection path |
| T-05-04 | Read-only GET /health; no write routes; no path traversal possible |
